# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.

completion:
Use the Inspect and Inventory the bridge report.
3. Take photos
4. Report all defects observed in the rails and guardrails
5. Estimate the age of the patch (on the bridge deck)

# How do structural defects affect the maintenance budget?

Structural defects affect the maintenance budget because they include any repairs necessary to ensure the safety of the bridge. Structural repairs include, patching the deck, repairing damaged guardrails and any other defects that could impair the safe use of the bridge.
